description: Triggers before SOP screenshots to systematically click every interactive element on the site, as a regression sweep after a batch of UI changes, when the user says "click through all the buttons", or whenever an interaction smoke test is needed. Driven by agent-browser plus a generalized traversal engine: click and observe every element on every screen, log to an eight-category ledger, and emit a JSONL ledger, a per-screen screenshot, and a report.
